Default angle style wraps URLs containing spaces in angle brackets

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{
		URLEscapeStyle: htmd.URLEscapeStyle(`angle`),
	}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<a href="/file (1).pdf">file</a>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
